blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Emilio Aguinaldo College strengthened its hold on third place in Group B with a 96-64 rout of San Sebastian in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Tuesday. The Generals improved to 4-6, while keeping the Golden Stags winless after 11 games. EAC’s MJ Raymundo, however, is not dwelling on the lopsided win, with the playoff race heating up and little separating the teams in the standings. “For me, this win adds up to our confidence but we can’t be happy about this,” Raymundo said in Filipino after dropping 17 points, six rebounds and three […]...
